title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Iron Straight Bar, Pipeline Collection Bathroom Hardware | Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable towel storage with this 18-Inch wall mount towel bar from the Pipeline collection. The straight bar delivers an industrial, pipe-fitting look that pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories, while keeping towels within easy reach.

Highlights:
- Pipeline collection design inspired by pipe fittings
- Iron construction with a durable powder-coated finish for a clean, decorative look
- Wall mount towel bar helps save floor space in the bathroom
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (color-coordinated)
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 18 inches
- Overall length: 18 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.75 inch
- Projection: 3.3 inches
- Dimensions: 18 in L x 3 in H x 3.3 in W
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"

_previous.description: The Pipeline collection is the latest innovation for bathroom fittings from the Allied Brass Brand of products. This towel bar gives the industrial look of pipe fittings while blending aptly with both modern and traditional bathroom decor. This accessory is powder coated with lifetime materials to provide a decorative and clean finish. No wonder, this towel bar gives continual service for years without any trouble. The choice of superior materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust. Towel bar mounts firmly with color coordinating screws and comes with a limited lifetime warranty.
